    SELECT t.account_id, t.balance
    FROM trans t
    INNER JOIN first_loan_client flc ON t.account_id = flc.account_id
    WHERE t.date = '1993-03-22'
    ORDER BY t.date DESC
    LIMIT 1
),
balance_end AS (
    SELECT t.account_id, t.balance
    FROM trans t
    INNER JOIN first_loan_client flc ON t.account_id = flc.account_id
    WHERE t.date = '1998-12-27'
    ORDER BY t.date DESC
    LIMIT 1
)
